name: Nasdaq Data Link
summary: Financial, economic and alternative datasets from Nasdaq Data Link through its Tables API: filter rows and columns of any table you can access, and read table metadata.

api_key.description: a Nasdaq Data Link API key (data.nasdaq.com account profile); calls work without one at much lower limits

notes: Tables are named PUBLISHER/TABLE (e.g. ETFG/FUND, MER/F1); premium tables need a subscription on the key's account.

Row filters are table-specific: only columns marked filterable in the table's documentation (or listed by tables.metadata) work, with operators .gt, .lt, .gte, .lte appended to the column name; several values are comma-separated.
At most 10,000 rows per call. Page with qopts.cursor_id, taken from next_cursor_id in the previous JSON response, until it is null. Rows are unsorted; sort locally.

Rate limits: anonymous 20 calls per 10 minutes and 50 a day (shared by all anonymous users); free keys 300 per 10 seconds, 2,000 per 10 minutes, 50,000 a day, one call at a time; premium subscribers 5,000 per 10 minutes and 720,000 a day.

endpoints.name: Get rows of a table
endpoints.summary: Rows of one table, filtered by its filterable columns, with chosen columns.

publisher.description: Publisher code, the part of the table code before the slash.

table.description: Table code, the part after the slash.

ticker.description: Row filter on a ticker column, for tables that have one; comma-separate several.

date.description: Row filter on a date column, for tables that have one.

date_gte.description: Rows with date on or after this.

date_lte.description: Rows with date on or before this.

notes: Only ticker and date filters are named here; a table's other filterable columns go through a raw call to the same path.
qopts.export=true (bulk zip export, subscribers only, 60 an hour) is left out: it starts an asynchronous file job rather than returning rows.

endpoints.name: Get table metadata
endpoints.summary: A table's columns, filterable fields, primary keys and refresh status.

publisher.description: Publisher code, the part of the table code before the slash.

table.description: Table code, the part after the slash.
